color.name: Jaundice
color.description: Yellowish pigmentation of the skin and sclerae

color.name: Pallor
color.description: Unusual lightness of skin color or pale mucous membranes/lips

color.name: Cyanosis
color.description: Bluish or purplish discoloration due to low oxygen saturation

color.name: Facial Flushing / Erythema
color.description: Reddening of the face due to fever, vasodilation or heat

structural_symmetric.name: Periorbital Edema
structural_symmetric.description: Swelling or puffiness around both eyes

structural_symmetric.name: Diaphoresis / Sweating
structural_symmetric.description: Visible beads of perspiration and sheen on the skin

structural_symmetric.name: Glassy Eyes
structural_symmetric.description: Unfocused, moist or glazed ocular appearance typical of fever

structural_asymmetric.name: Ptosis (Drooping Eyelid)
structural_asymmetric.description: Abnormal low-lying upper eyelid on one or both sides (Horner, palsy, myasthenia)

structural_asymmetric.name: Facial Droop / Asymmetry
structural_asymmetric.description: Weakness and downward sagging of mouth angle or nasolabial fold (stroke, Bell's palsy)

secretions.name: Rhinorrhea / Runny Nose
secretions.description: Excessive clear or mucoid nasal discharge

secretions.name: Epiphora / Weepy Eyes
secretions.description: Overflow of tears onto the face
